cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Builds a prefilled GitHub Issue-Forms URL for proposing a new AINumbers fintech tool, OpenChainGraph compute node, or verifiable workflow. Returns the URL only -- it never posts to GitHub on the caller's behalf. Companion to the site's mailto suggestion form (suggest.html); this is the agent-callable path.

computes.description: What the tool would compute or verify (e.g. "validates a CBAM precursor emissions declaration against Annex III default values"). Required by the issue form.

domain.description: The regulation or standard it serves (e.g. "MiCA", "ISO 20022", "EMIR Refit").

kind.description: What kind of suggestion this is (default "New tool").

title.description: Short issue title (the "[Suggestion] " prefix is added automatically).

who.description: The persona or buyer who would use this (e.g. "a compliance officer at a CASP").

why_now.description: The driver, deadline, or demand behind the suggestion.

name: suggest_tool_idea
title: Suggest a new tool, node, or workflow
